title: SDK brain dump — quick fixes & sample app ideas
content:
Quick brain dump (clean up later)
Date: 2026-03-10 — follow-ups 03-12

Top priority fixes (short-term)
- docs/getting-started: onboarding snippet still references old API v1 header. Quick patch: show fetch + Node SDK example side-by-side. (GH #487 — PR opened but needs test)
- examples/echo-bot: sample app crashes on large messages (OOM) when KV cache not configured. Add a note: set maxTokens & enable prefix caching for local dev. File: examples/echo-bot/README.md TODO.
- CLI tutorial: `ri init` flow skips region selection if env var set; needs explicit note in tutorial that env var overrides prompt. Users confused in community thread (#devx-help).

Medium-term (this sprint?)
- sample apps suite: create a pared-down webchat (React + serverless) that demonstrates streaming, tool-calling, and function schema. Target: 1-page tutorial on console -> deploy -> run. Tasks:
  * repo scaffold (template): name `ri-sample-chat`
  * add telemetry-free config and instructions for Dedicated vs Hosted endpoints
  * include an integration test that runs locally with a small model (quantized)

Documentation gaps I keep bumping into
- missing clear guidance on when to use embeddings vs reranking for small corpora (<=20 docs). Write short decision tree and sample cost calc.
- SDK: lack of examples for `response_format` + structured output validation (JSON schema). Add a tiny example of schema + validation using AJV in Node.
- Observability: link to Console tracing API is buried. Make top-level doc under "Console -> Tracing" with quick trace example showing per-request token cost.

Notes / micro-reminders (things I want to jot down)
- Ask SRE if there's a recommended default for batch_size vs latency for Dedicated (NVIDIA H100 baseline). Add to infra Qs.
- Marco suggested a tiny benchmark script (curl-based) to show HEADERS only vs streaming cost. Follow up and PR to `benchmark/`
- Add a "common pitfall" callout for sample apps: forgetting to pin model version leads to different behavior when rolling. Example: `gpt-x-1` -> suddenly returns slightly different completions. Suggest pinning strategy in sample apps.

Unresolved questions / decision points
- Should the sample-chat tutorial include function/tool-calling by default, or is that advanced? Pros: shows power. Cons: complexity for newcomers. Leaning to include simple function-calling example but mark as "advanced" section.
- Document format for tutorials: do we prefer single-page long-form or split into micro-guides? Ops wants micro-guides for SEO; devx wants single flow. Might compromise: single "guide" with anchors + separate micro-guides for deep dives.

Snippets / copy ideas for README
- "Start small: use our hosted sandbox to validate prompts before moving to Dedicated. Pin model versions to avoid surprises during rollouts."
- Quick code sample (Node):
  const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RI_KEY });
  const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/ggml-13b-q4_0', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Summarize the README'}] });
  console.log(res.output[0].content);

Tasks (checklist)
- [ ] Update getting-started snippet for Node + fetch (PR to docs)
- [ ] Fix echo-bot README and add KV cache note
- [ ] Draft short decision tree: embeddings vs rerank
- [ ] Create `ri-sample-chat` scaffold (initial commit) — include CI job (light)
- [ ] Add schema validation example in SDK docs
- [ ] Small benchmark script PR to `benchmark/`

Priority next 48h
1) Finish getting-started PR (blocking community onboarding)
2) Echo-bot README fix + small repro for OOM case (so infra can reproduce)
3) Start `ri-sample-chat` scaffold repo (placeholder README + deployment notes)

Random thoughts to polish later
- Could make a "mini workshop" slide deck for new hires showing API patterns + pitfalls (10 slides). Good onboarding asset.
- Example apps should have a toggle: "Use Hosted (sandbox)" vs "Use Local"; code paths should be trivially switchable via env var.

References / links I keep hitting:
- GH PR (work-in-progress): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/487
- Linear ticket for sample apps: LIN-2147
- Confluence draft: confluence://devx/sdk-getting-started

Notes to self: keep this one-page dump short, move things into proper GH issues / PR descriptions. Archive once checklist is clear.

-- Nora
